title: Endless Summer Vacation Rental
meta_description: Endless Summer is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionEndless SummerBrand New to the Rental MarketWaterColor Beach CommunityE Royal Fern Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights5 bedrooms (see room configurations under “Room Details”)5.5 bathroomsSleeps up to 12 guests4,200 sq. ft. of indoor living space1,300 sq. ft. of outdoor living including multiple porches, private pool, and patioWaterColor Shuttle pickup just a few doors downPrivate pool—one of the largest in WaterColor—with spa (circulating hot tub; no jets)Pool house bathroom for added conveniencePool/spa heating available upon request for an additional fee, weather permitting (cannot be heated separately)Outdoor showerBuilt-in gas grill + under-counter ice maker in pool areaSerene backyard with multiple seating areas + outdoor wood-burning fireplace (firewood not provided)First-floor laundry room with full-size washer & dryerDriveway parking for 4 vehiclesGarage not available to guestsFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals upon request)Pet considered: 1 hypoallergenic dog max, 25 lb. weight limit; $250 non-refundable fee per pet; prior approval requiredTwo exterior Ring cameras (side door & front entry) for securityProperty OverviewWelcome to Endless Summer, a luxurious retreat where upscale comfort meets effortless coastal living. Brand new to the rental market, this 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home is thoughtfully designed for families and groups seeking style, convenience, and exceptional amenities.First FloorStep inside to an inviting, newly furnished interior with curated décor and generous natural light. The primary suite offers a serene escape with a king bed, spa-like bathroom, walk-in shower, and soaking tub. The chef-inspired kitchen features premium appliances, expansive counter space, and an open layout perfect for entertaining. A spacious living area with plush seating and a large TV creates the ideal spot for movie nights or relaxed gatherings.Guests will also enjoy two additional first-floor living spaces, offering room for everyone to unwind.Second FloorUpstairs, a dedicated workspace accommodates remote work or study needs. Three beautifully appointed bedrooms provide comfort and privacy, including:A bunk room with a twin-over-queen bunk and private bathA guest room with a king bed and private bathA guest room with two queen beds and private bathPool HouseA rare perk—your private pool house includes a king bed and full bathroom with a walk-in shower.Outdoor LivingThe backyard is all about relaxation and recreation. Enjoy one of WaterColor’s largest private pools, an attached spa, sun deck, outdoor shower, and a built-in gas grill perfect for alfresco dining. Cooler evenings welcome cozy gatherings around the outdoor wood-burning fireplace.Pool Heating: Available October–April for an additional fee, weather permitting. Heating is unavailable when outdoor temperatures remain below 50°F or above 80°F.Community AmenitiesWaterColor is known for its nature-forward design, exceptional amenities, and seamless access to 30A’s most beautiful coastal landscapes. Enjoy:Multiple community poolsCamp WaterColorWaterColor Beach ClubPrivate community beach accessWaterColor Town Center with dining & shoppingAccess to Western Lake, the largest coastal dune lake in South WaltonParks, green spaces & playgroundNature trails & pedestrian pathsWellness amenities including WaterColor Boathouse, tennis & pickleball (fees may apply)Guest Access RequirementsWaterColor requires wristbands for all guests ages 5+ for pool and beach access.Wristbands cannot be added after arrival.You must provide the accurate number of guests at booking or no later than 2 weeks before arrival.The HOA strictly enforces a maximum of 12 guests, and will not issue more than 12 wristbands. No exceptions.Golf CartsGolf cart rentals are managed exclusively through The Electric Cart Company.Limited availability (approx. 45 carts per week community-wide)Only one cart allowed per homeFirst-come, first-servedIf a cart is included with the home (this home does not include one), it counts as your single allowable cart.ParkingParking for 4 vehicles in the drivewayGarage not accessible to guestsVehicle registration is required prior to arrivalReservation & Booking PoliciesNote: The 30A Cottages & Concierge Rental Agreement supersedes any third-party booking site policies (VRBO, HomeAway, etc.). Third-party service fees are non-refundable.No smokingRates do not include taxes & fees50% of total due at bookingRemaining balance due 60 days before arrival (or in full for bookings made within 60 days)Except for a 5% cancellation fee, the initial 50% payment is refundable when canceling more than 60 days before arrivalTravel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment)Check-in: 4:00 PM CST Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTPrimary renter must be 25+ years old and stay on-site for the entire rental period

2nd Floor Bunk Room: Bunk Beds (1 Twin & 1 Queen) - Private Full Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo
2nd Floor King Guest Bedroom: King - Private Full Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo
2nd Floor Queen Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds - Private Full Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo
Carriage House Bedroom: King - Private Full Bathroom with Shower
